$comment: Voice suite (docs/runbooks/conversation-lab.md): a true voice call, headless. Amazon Polly speaks each line as the synthetic founder (conversation_lab/voice.py writes WAVs); Chromium hears line 1 through its fake microphone device (--use-file-for-fake-audio-capture, after `leadSilenceSeconds` so the vEIR's greeting ends first) and the later lines mixed into the same microphone stream when the call is listening (apps/web/e2e/lab/voice.lab.ts). The app streams the microphone to Amazon Transcribe, answers on the real model and speaks with Amazon Polly (muted). `bargeIn` lines start while the vEIR is still speaking, `bargeInDelayMs` after its reply begins. Lines avoid digits so the word error rate measures hearing, not number formatting.

lines.text: Hi, it's Maya. I have a few minutes before my next class, so let's be quick.
We're trying to decide between charging each library branch separately or one flat fee for the whole campus.
Sorry to cut in, what would you charge for a short pilot instead?
That makes sense. Thanks, let's pick this up again tomorrow.
